title: Simon Peck Summer Series 2017
text:
Preparations for our 2017 Summer Series are well underway. These events are an excellent introduction to the sport - beginners, including families, are welcome. Walk or run, individually or in small groups - it's your choice!

Experienced members are not forgotten - there will be a more challenging course for them, and coaching is also available at each event. SuffOC members should have received an email detailing the latter; please contact Clive if you wish to take part.
